_comment: Manual overrides for coaches where TM data lags reality. 'sacked' = coach left, treat club as vacancy (unless 'appointed' fills it). 'appointed' = confirmed incoming head coach TM hasn't listed yet; generator swaps the stale scraped HC for this one. 'sd' = sporting director override when TM classifies them as other_staff. Remove entries once TM is updated and staff re-scraped.
